test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 

Your explanation was simpler ______ Rekha's explanation.
solution:
"The correct answer is option 4, "**than**."

The sentence is comparing two explanations "your explanation" and "Rekha's explanation." The word "simpler" indicates that one explanation is easier to understand than the other. Therefore, we need a word that shows comparison. "Than" is a comparative conjunction that is used to compare two things. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is comparing two explanations. 
 
• The word "simpler" indicates that one explanation is easier to understand than the other. 
 
• We need a word that shows comparison. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Of" is a preposition that is used to show possession or relationship between two things. It is not appropriate in this context. 
 
• "That" is a conjunction that is used to introduce a subordinate clause. It is not appropriate in this context. 
 
• "Then" is an adverb that is used to indicate time or sequence. It is not appropriate in this context."
